_comment: Reusable fixes. A profile or a dependency references a recipe by name and the engine applies it, so the same remedy is written once instead of being repeated for every title. Fields mean the same as in a game profile: dll_overrides, registry, env, launch_arguments, windows_version, dependencies, and requires for other recipes. 'category' is the failure class the fix belongs to (see app/Madeira/CompatDiagnosis.swift). Nothing here needs Linux, Vulkan or a Proton runtime: each recipe is an override, a registry value, an environment variable, an argument or a component.

native-ddraw.title: Native ddraw
native-ddraw.summary: Prefer the game's own ddraw.dll; Wine's builtin one lacks the DirectDraw-era behaviour some 1998-2003 titles need.

native-d3d8.title: Native Direct3D 8
native-d3d8.summary: Some D3D8 titles only render with a native d3d8.dll from the DirectX redistributable.

native-dsound.title: Native DirectSound
native-dsound.summary: Titles whose mixer or EAX support exists only in the native dsound.dll.

native-winmm.title: Native winmm
native-winmm.summary: Native winmm for titles that open MIDI or the MCI sequencer, or that must see a specific winmm version.

native-dinput.title: Native DirectInput
native-dinput.summary: Prefer the game's own dinput.dll so a bundled proxy or mapper is loaded.

broad-dinput8.title: Broad dinput8
broad-dinput8.summary: Prefer a native dinput8.dll when the game ships one, and fall back to Wine's builtin otherwise.

builtin-dinput8.title: Builtin dinput8
builtin-dinput8.summary: Force Wine's builtin dinput8 for titles broken by a native one.

native-xinput.title: Native XInput
native-xinput.summary: Native xinput1_3/1_4 for titles that reject Wine's builtin stubs.

native-winhttp.title: Native winhttp
native-winhttp.summary: Native winhttp for launchers whose TLS or proxy handling fails on the builtin.

native-dwmapi.title: Native dwmapi
native-dwmapi.summary: Native dwmapi for titles that query DWM composition and refuse to start on the stub.

native-dwrite.title: Native dwrite
native-dwrite.summary: Native dwrite for titles whose text layout needs the real DirectWrite.

disable-dcomp.title: Disable DirectComposition
disable-dcomp.summary: Titles that pick DirectComposition for their swapchain and then fail to present.

native-version.title: Native version.dll
native-version.summary: Titles that read version resources from a native version.dll.

native-d3dcompiler.title: Native D3D shader compilers
native-d3dcompiler.summary: Native d3dcompiler_43/46/47 for titles that hit a compiler bug in the builtin compiler.

native-d3dx9.title: Native D3DX9
native-d3dx9.summary: The D3DX9 helper DLLs are not implemented by Wine; a Direct3D 9 title that links them needs the native files.

native-gdiplus.title: Native gdiplus
native-gdiplus.summary: Native gdiplus for titles that hit a rendering or image-decoding bug in the builtin.

native-msxml.title: Native MSXML
native-msxml.summary: Native MSXML 3, 4 and 6 for launchers and games that parse XML through MSXML.

native-richedit.title: Native rich edit
native-richedit.summary: Native riched20/riched30 for titles whose in-game text or console needs the real control.

video-quartz.title: Native DirectShow video
video-quartz.summary: Wine's builtin quartz has no working decoders on iOS, so titles that play a video need the native filter graph and codecs.

video-media-foundation.title: Media Foundation video
video-media-foundation.summary: Titles that decode video through Media Foundation (mfplat/mfreadwrite) instead of DirectShow.

video-wmv.title: Windows Media video
video-wmv.summary: WMV/VC-1 playback, used by many intros and cutscenes.

audio-xact.title: XACT audio
audio-xact.summary: xactengine2_0..3_7 plus X3DAudio/XAPOFX: the DirectX sound engine of the D3D9 era.

audio-openal.title: OpenAL
audio-openal.summary: OpenAL32/wrap_oal for id Tech and other engines that ship or link OpenAL.

audio-directmusic.title: DirectMusic
audio-directmusic.summary: The DirectX 9 DirectMusic set, used by 2000s titles for soundtrack playback.

physx-legacy.title: Legacy PhysX
physx-legacy.summary: PhysXLoader/PhysXCore for titles from the Unreal Engine 3 era that link the pre-2.8 runtime.

dotnet-desktop.title: .NET desktop runtime
dotnet-desktop.summary: Titles that need the .NET Framework rather than wine-mono, at a Windows 10 version.

unicode-fonts.title: Core and Unicode fonts
unicode-fonts.summary: Arial, Times, Courier and the CJK-capable fonts some engines measure text against.

launcher-webview.title: Launcher web view
launcher-webview.summary: Launchers and store clients that render their UI in an embedded browser need wininet/urlmon and WebView2.

steam-offline.title: Steam offline launch
steam-offline.summary: Start a Steam title as its own program in offline mode, without waiting for the client.

steam-no-overlay.title: Disable the Steam overlay
steam-no-overlay.summary: The overlay hook can crash older D3D9 titles; the game still runs without it.

engine-dx11.title: Direct3D 11 renderer
engine-dx11.summary: Unreal Engine 3 and 4 titles that default to another RHI but work through -dx11.

engine-dx9.title: Direct3D 9 renderer
engine-dx9.summary: Titles whose Direct3D 11 path fails on DXMT but whose Direct3D 9 path works.

engine-fna-d3d11.title: FNA Direct3D 11 backend
engine-fna-d3d11.summary: FNA has no OpenGL backend on iOS, so its D3D11 backend is selected explicitly.

windowed-borderless.title: Borderless window
windowed-borderless.summary: Some titles only present correctly in a borderless window on iOS.

skip-splash.title: Skip the splash screen
skip-splash.summary: A splash that hangs on a video or a network check can be skipped.

windows-xp.title: Report Windows XP
windows-xp.summary: Pre-2007 titles that refuse to start on a newer reported Windows version.

windows-7.title: Report Windows 7
windows-7.summary: Titles that check for a Windows 7-or-later API set.

windows-10.title: Report Windows 10
windows-10.summary: Titles that require Windows 10 to start or to expose their D3D11/D3D12 path.

installer-mode-msi.title: MSI installation supported
installer-mode-msi.summary: Wine's builtin msi can run a self-extracting redistributable's MSI payload; keep it builtin.

nocd-disc-check.title: Disc-check bypass
nocd-disc-check.summary: Titles whose SafeDisc/SecuROM check reads the original disc; no disc image can satisfy it on iOS.
